solution:
**Calculation**

Students studying in class IX of schools Q and R together = 157 + 143

= 300

Students studying in class VI of schools S and T together = 142 + 144

= 286

The ratio of the two = 300 : 286

= 150 : 143

**The respective ratio of students studying in class IX of schools Q and R together to those studying in class VI of schools S and T together is 150:143.**
